title: No Letters in PDF Preview for  PDF created by Stuttgarter Zeitung

judgment.rationale: The reporter confirmed the blank-text symptom in 0.86.0 and supplied comparison screenshots, but no affected PDF is included and the report predates pinned source. A representative document and current result are the discriminating evidence.
evidence: Original report uses 0.75.1 and says downloaded Stuttgarter Zeitung PDFs show no letters in PowerToys preview.
No sample PDF is attached in the snapshot.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a safe-to-share affected document and a current-version retest; do not ask for generic logs.

fix_assessment.rationale: Without the affected document or a current reproduction, the failure cannot be attributed to parser support or a regression in the current code.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys PDF preview reportedly rendered no letters for PDFs from Stuttgarter Zeitung.
known_information: No sample PDF or current-version confirmation is present.
inferences: The document may use PDF features or fonts unsupported by the preview path, but the screenshots do not identify which.
issue_context.analysis: A sample that reproduces the empty text is required to identify the relevant PDF structure.
initial_investigation: Read original report and maintainer/author follow-up.
Snapshot has screenshot references but no actual PDF attachment.

information_gaps.information: A representative PDF from Stuttgarter Zeitung that shows blank text in the PowerToys preview, or a redacted sample with the same PDF structure, plus the current PowerToys version.
information_gaps.why_needed: The author confirmed the issue in 0.86.0 and supplied comparison screenshots, but no affected PDF is included; the sample distinguishes unsupported PDF structure from a rendering regression.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retry on current release and attach one affected PDF that is safe to share. If it contains private content, use a redacted copy retaining the same page structure and fonts; report the version.

comment.body: Thanks for confirming the blank-text result in 0.86.0 and providing the comparison screenshots. Could you retry on the current release and attach one affected PDF that is safe to share? If the newspaper file contains private information, a redacted copy retaining the same page structure and fonts is useful. Please include the current PowerToys version so we can tell whether this is still present before examining PDF parsing behavior.
